# hermes-maintainer

> Independent community notes on the non-obvious parts of `NousResearch/hermes-agent` (not official Nous policy), plus a local, read-only backlog graph with an xyflow explorer and an opt-in local Hermes ACP chat. The graph's GitHub access is **read-only**; nothing here writes upstream. Facts re-measured 2026-11-24 at hermes-agent main `8545fee`.

Upstream source at a stated SHA beats anything here. Every number on a knowledge page has a date and a reproducible `gh` query.

## Non-obvious Hermes knowledge

- [Start here](./knowledge/START_HERE.md): reading order and first-session path.
- [Invariants](./knowledge/INVARIANTS.md): prompt-cache stability, narrow core and the footprint ladder, profile-aware paths, config.yaml vs .env, rejected PR shapes.
- [Testing](./knowledge/TESTING.md): scripts/run_tests.sh, isolated HERMES_HOME, real-home guard, banned test shapes.
- [Security and CI](./knowledge/SECURITY_AND_CI.md): approvals are accident prevention (SECURITY.md §2.2/§2.4); the fork-PR CI approval gate; forks get no secrets.
- [How work lands](./knowledge/HOW_WORK_LANDS.md): salvage/carrier PRs; measure commits on main, never PRs merged.
- [Who maintains what](./knowledge/WHO_MAINTAINS_WHAT.md): mergers, reviewers, areas, response times, merge hours.
- [Plugins and sibling repos](./knowledge/PLUGINS_AND_REPOS.md): catalog SHA pinning; NousResearch plugin repos and their mergers.
- [Current public work](./knowledge/CURRENT_PUBLIC_WORK.md): board size and a dated open-issue radar; not a roadmap.
- [Triage waves](./knowledge/TRIAGE_WAVES.md), [Review evidence](./knowledge/REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md), [Public cases](./knowledge/PUBLIC_CASES.md), [Architecture routing](./knowledge/HERMES_INTENT.md), [Source policy](./knowledge/SOURCE_POLICY.md).

## Graph tool docs

- [README](./README.md): install, scan, serve.
- [Get started](./GET_STARTED.md), [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) (workers never merge), [Local ACP webapp](./docs/ACP_WEBAPP.md).
- [PRD](./docs/PRD.md), [Architecture](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Schemas](./docs/SCHEMAS.md), [Security](./docs/SECURITY.md), [Operations](./docs/OPERATIONS.md), [Roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md).
- [Maintainer activity data](./docs/MAINTAINERS-ACTIVITY.md): raw output of scripts/maintainer-activity.py.
- Do not collapse `similar`, `duplicate_of`, `same_root_cause`, `partially_addresses` and `supersedes` into one relation.

## Code

- [CLI](./src/hermes_maintainer/cli.py): `init`, `scan`, `analyze`, `serve`, `daemon`, `doctor`
- [FastAPI app](./src/hermes_maintainer/api/app.py): `/api/graph`, campaign explorer, `/llms.txt`
- [Graph store](./src/hermes_maintainer/graph/store.py), [Campaign builder](./src/hermes_maintainer/analysis/campaigns.py), [SQLite schema](./src/hermes_maintainer/schema.sql)
- [xyflow graph UI](./src/hermes_maintainer/ui/graph-src/graph-app.jsx), bundled to `ui/static/graph-app.js`

## Optional / historical

- [Seed audit](./seed/audit/HERMES_TRIAGE_AUDIT.md): September 2026 campaign seeds, not live truth. [Campaign seeds](./seed/audit/campaign_seeds.json) power the demo graph.
- [Archive](./archive/README.md): September 2026 working notes, historical only.
